actions.description: Inspect host environment and builder-app unit
actions.command: cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---"; systemctl --version 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo "---"; which python3 python; echo "---"; ls -la /opt/builder/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; systemctl cat builder-app.service 2>/dev/null; echo "---STATUS---"; systemctl status builder-app.service 2>/dev/null

ls -la /opt 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls -la /var/lib 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; python3 --version; echo "---"; mount | grep -E ' / | /opt | /var ' ; echo "---"; systemctl is-enabled builder-app.service
